reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getFillableCategories so five actions get it from one place; copyPreviousMonth keeps using its own pre-existing filter.

duplication.why: The 'unless includeHiddenCategories, skip hidden or group-hidden' rule is written twice: as a conditional SQL fragment in getFillableCategories and as a boolean guard in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The flag lives in the shared selection in budget/actions.ts; only copyPreviousMonth applies it at the call site, following the tree's existing split.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing through month-wide actions and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and readable; the hidden rule still has two homes because copyPreviousMonth was left on its own filter path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth (budget/actions.ts) decides the hidden/includeHiddenCategories rule inline instead of through getFillableCategories (a pre-existing bypass that this diff extends).

disguised_duplication.where: The same hidden rule appears as an interpolated SQL WHERE fragment in getFillableCategories and as a negated boolean expression in copyPreviousMonth.
